name: alerts-budget
description: The alert storm with a budget of 12 credits per alert: detectors cost 1, hypothesis 5, diagnosis 4. A producer that injects a non-critical alert lowers its budget to half, so its expensive call is refused once the cheap detectors have spent their share.

neurons.description: Where alerts enter. The producer tags each with a replaces key (its service).
Flags an alert when the log has error lines for its service.
Flags an alert when its service was deployed in the last 30 minutes.
Flags a critical alert when the service's error rate is above 5%.
A 500 ms stand-in for a model call; acts once two distinct detectors flag one alert.
Composed: finds the root cause and the deploy to look at.
